title: Constant space diagrams are represented by mapping spaces
statement: Use the infinity-category of $\mathcal U$-small spaces and coherent limits from [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $K$ be a $\mathcal U$-small Kan complex and let $X$ be a $\mathcal U$-small space. The constant coherent diagram $\Delta_KX:K\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ has a limit, canonically identified with $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}}(K,X)$. Under this identification the limiting cone is the evaluation cone $\Delta_K\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}}(K,X)\to\Delta_KX$, the coherent transformation determined by the simplicial evaluation map $K\times\operatorname{Fun}(K,X)\to X$: its component at $k\in K$ sends a map $K\to X$ to its value at $k$. The identification is natural in maps of Kan complexes, in $X$, and with all coherent simplicial parameters; it also includes $K=\varnothing$.
